posts.en:
dsh-web-auth is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0774b974aef435be23f9.html
